meta.title: Brand assets | InkyBay
meta.description: Download the InkyBay logo, colors and typeface, and read the usage guidelines for partners, affiliates and press.

title: Brand assets
for partners and affiliates.
hero.lead: Logos, colors and type for writing about InkyBay, listing it in your directory or promoting it to your audience. Follow the guidelines below so the brand looks right wherever it appears.
hero.note: By downloading or using these assets you agree to the usage guidelines on this page.

logos.title: Logos
logos.lead: Every logo comes as SVG and as a transparent 2048px PNG.

items.name: Full logo
items.text: The icon, wordmark and tagline. The default logo for white and light backgrounds.

items.name: Full logo
items.text: The same lockup with a white tagline, for dark backgrounds, dark interfaces and video.

items.name: Icon
items.text: For app listings, avatars and favicons, and anywhere the brand needs a square tile.

title: Colors
from the ink.
colors.lead: Red and orange come from the app icon's ink gradient. Use them for the logo and accents, and charcoal for text on white. Select a color to copy its hex.

type.title: Typography
type.lead: Poppins is the InkyBay typeface for the logo, graphics and marketing material. It is free on Google Fonts under the Open Font License.

scale.name: Body
scale.sample: Body text carries the detail, so it stays easy to read at any length.

scale.name: Small
scale.sample: Labels, helper text and secondary details.

title: Usage guidelines
keep the brand recognizable.
usage.lead: A few simple rules keep the InkyBay logo clear and consistent, wherever it appears.

clear.title: Clear space
clear.text: Keep a clear space of X around the logo on every side, where X is half the height of the icon. No text, images or edges inside it.

min.title: Minimum size
min.text: Below these sizes the tagline and the icon's details stop reading clearly.

items.title: Light backgrounds
items.text: Use the full logo on light.

items.title: Dark backgrounds
items.text: Use the full logo on dark.

items.title: Square or small spaces
items.text: Use the icon on its own.
Add shadows, outlines or other effects.
Place the logo on a busy background.
Use a version with too little contrast.
Use the wordmark without the icon.
Crowd the logo inside its clear space.

name.title: Writing our name
name.text: InkyBay is one word with a capital I and a capital B. Never change it, translate it or use it as a verb.

rules.title: Trademark use
items: Use our name and assets only to refer to InkyBay, for example in partner and app directories, reviews, tutorials and affiliate promotions.
Don't suggest that InkyBay sponsors or endorses you, your company or your products unless we have agreed to it in writing.
Don't use the InkyBay name or logo in your own product, company, domain or social account names.
When you use our logo or name on a web page, link it to the InkyBay website.
Use the brand respectfully. We may ask you to change or stop any use that doesn't follow these guidelines.

help.title: Need another format?
help.text: Write to our brand team for other formats, press questions or anything these guidelines don't cover.
